name: Tegan Novák
source: A European foreign student, Tegan specializes in Computer Science. He loves to program and spends the majority of his time in front of the computer. He also loves robotics and any kind of engineering. He has the second highest GPA of the school, beaten only by Tadashi. But despite his adorkableness and his intelligence, Tegan faces a lot of pressure from people… people who won’t believe in him and his dreams. His roommate and best friend is Tyler and he has a twin sister: Karolina.
